Here is a negative Amazon review about a foam mattress in eight sentences:

**1 Star - Save Your Money and Your Back**

I purchased this foam mattress two months ago with high hopes after reading the glowing reviews, but I deeply regret this decision. Within the first two weeks, the mattress had already started to sag significantly in the middle, making it nearly impossible to sleep comfortably. The foam emits a terrible chemical smell that has not gone away despite airing it out for over a week, and it fills the entire bedroom with an unpleasant odor. I wake up every single morning with lower back pain that I never experienced before sleeping on this mattress. The product description claimed it was a medium-firm feel, but in reality it is so soft that I feel like I am sinking into quicksand every night. The mattress also retains an enormous amount of body heat, leaving me sweating through the night even with the air conditioning running. When I attempted to contact customer service about these issues, I received a generic automated response and never heard back from a real person. I would strongly advise anyone considering this purchase to spend a little extra money on a quality mattress, because this one is an absolute waste of money and a danger to your spinal health.
